title: FermiumLITE
body:
# Fermium LITE
A Lighter, Optimization Focused version of **Fermium!**

## What is this for?
FermiumLite aims to be as stable as possible, whilst making the game as fast as possible!

## Features!
- A lot of optimizatiton Mods
- Shader support (iris)
- Some texturepacks for redstotne/pvp
- Cactus mod

Made with 💚 by Lumi
